text:
incident-bot: INCIDENT P1 — high GPU queue growth (us-east4). Autoscaler failing to provision GPUs. Pager triggered. Runbook: /runbooks/gpu-quota. Notifying on-call.

elena (oncall): on it. seeing alerts for high queue length and 5xx on the inference API. what region exactly?

incident-bot: region: us-east4, cluster: infer-prod-east4, affected pools: gpu-t4-pool-1. Queue: 127 -> 642 in 9m. Autoscaler error rate increasing.

mike (eng-runtime): confirming. our autoscaler shows repeated failures creating nodes. sample from autoscaler logs:
```
E0314 14:02:11 autoscaler.go:212] instance creation failed: quotaExceeded: Quota 'GPUS' exceeded for project redwood-prod in region us-east4
Caused by: quota 'GPUS' with value 0 available
```

alex (sre): also seeing k8s events: `FailedScheduling` for pods, reason=InsufficientAccelerator, message="0/10 nodes are available: 10 Insufficient accelerator/gpu". Pods are Pending for ~6-8m.

elena (oncall): impact? which customers hit? any customer-facing errors?

jen (support): Support dashboards show spike in 5xx for model-generation route. Top impacted customers: BeaconAI (chat streaming errors), NimbleChat (high latency/timeouts). Estimated affected requests ~10-15% of production token volume in last 15m.

mike (eng-runtime): root cause: we attempted scheduled scale-up after a traffic spike, but GCP region quota for GPUs is exhausted — so node pools cannot grow. Quick mitigation options: 1) enable routing fallback to another region (eu-west1) 2) reduce model memory to fit more replicas per GPU (quantized models) 3) enable CPU fallback path for low-priority traffic 4) ask GCP for emergency quota bump (slow).

alex (sre): doing region fallback now. flipping routing flag `enable_region_fallback=true` for prod routes to allow spill to eu-west1. Also lowering per-customer QPS limits to reduce burst.

elena (oncall): please post commands + short verification once done. also start contact with cloud ops to request quota increase.

mike (eng-runtime): running small change to routing config:
```
PATCH /config/routing
{"enable_region_fallback": true, "max_batch_size": 4, "global_qps_cap": 12000}
```

incident-bot: CHANGE applied by mike (eng-runtime).

jen (support): posting CS note: "We are seeing partial service interruption for inference in us-east4. Teams are routing some traffic to eu-west1. Customers may notice increased latency. Engineers are working on remediation."

alex (sre): verifying effect — queue in us-east4 dropped from 642 -> 120 in ~3m after fallback. eu-west1 queue up from 30 -> 210. Overall tail latency rose ~200ms for routed requests.

elena (oncall): good. can we throttle heavy-traffic customers to reduce load while quota request is pending?

mike (eng-runtime): enabled per-customer rate limits for top 10 customers and set low-priority routing to CPU fallback for non-realtime workloads. Also deployed a small model variant (quantized-8bit) as a degraded fallback for streaming where acceptable.

mike (eng-runtime): command attempts to create a GPU instance to repro the quota error:
```
gcloud compute instances create test-gpu --zone=us-east4-a --accelerator=type=nvidia-tesla-t4,count=1
ERROR: (gcloud.compute.instances.create) Quota 'GPUS' exceeded for region 'us-east4'.
```

elena (oncall): opened cloud support ticket with GCP (ticket: GCP-567890). Requested emergency quota increase for GPUs in us-east4. ETA TBD.

lina (cs): letting affected customers know: BeaconAI is on call and acknowledged duplicate routes; they reported resumed functionality after failover but higher latency.

alex (sre): next steps: 1) leave routing fallback on until quota increased or capacity stabilized 2) follow up with infra to request permanent quota increases + document limits 3) run a post-incident action to improve autoscaler heuristics to avoid thrashing into quota limits 4) add circuit-breaker to prevent full-queue pileups.

elena (oncall): handing off to alex for overnight watch. I'm logging the incident and will prepare the timeline for postmortem.

alex (sre): taking over. Current status: degraded but mitigated via region fallback and throttles. Queue stable across regions; no new 5xx spikes. Will monitor for 2h then close.

jen (support): CS follow-up: created internal post to affected customers, offered support calls, logged incidents for BeaconAI and NimbleChat.

mike (eng-runtime): follow-up PRs: routing rollback safety (PR #6421), autoscaler retry backoff tuning (PR #6423).

elena (oncall): ACTION ITEMS: infra to file quota change doc + apply for reserve; infra/eng to run tabletop for cross-region failover; product to review degraded model UX.

incident-bot: INCIDENT status -> mitigated (P1->P2). Handed off to alex (sre).

alex (sre): closing update at 14:22 UTC — queue stable, regional traffic split ~70% eu-west1 / 30% us-east4 for heavy GPUs. Will keep monitoring and produce postmortem.
